EmailTemplate.description: Help Desk template to direct to submit ticket in My ASU
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Help Desk - My ASU
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University. This email is in response to a case we received via My ASU. We were able to research your question.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
For help and support, contact ASU, visit the Service Center in My ASU, or call 1-855-278-5080.
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
